text: Thereupon followed a demonstration that tyranny knows no ideological confines. Trujillo's dictatorship had been along conservative, right-wing lines. But after the censure, he and his propaganda started mouthing Communist slogans. There was considerable evidence of a tacit rapprochement with Castro in Cuba, previously a bête noire to Trujillo, thus illustrating the way in which totalitarianism of the right and left coalesces.
